name: book-translator
purpose: Agent-native, resumable literary book translation with source-comparison review.

version_policy.rule: Use the latest main when the user does not explicitly pin a tag, commit, or branch.

completion_requirement: Every intended chapter is reviewed under AGENTS.md and repository state validates.

capability_fallbacks.filesystem_and_git: Clone latest main and work locally/in the user's repository.
capability_fallbacks.repository_api_without_shell: Read canonical instructions and create/update equivalent workspace files through the available repository API.
capability_fallbacks.read_only: Read the instructions, state exactly what cannot be performed, and give the minimum manual step needed. Do not claim setup or file writes occurred.
